headline: A 2001 executive order on community-based living options for people with disabilities, as an alternative to living in institutions.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with federal policy on community-based alternatives for people with disabilities. This likely means options such as getting care and support at home or in the community instead of in an institution. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order concerns their access to options for living and getting support in the community rather than in institutions.
Executive orders direct the work of federal agencies, but the specific duties in this order are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 18, 2001. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, but no specific date is given in the available material.
